observations: A large arched form in olive and brown occupies the center, outlined in white with a jagged lower edge; a smaller open-mouthed figure with visible teeth sits at upper left.
Loose gold spiral lines scatter across the central mass, while blue dashes and a white vertical stripe interrupt the warm earth tones mid-composition.
The background is packed with overlapping horizontal bars, loops, and zigzag lines in orange, pink, green, teal, and red, leaving almost no unworked space around the central form.
reading: A broad arched shape, earthy and dense, anchors the image while a smaller snarling figure crowds the upper left corner. The two forms pull against each other in scale and mood. Gold spirals drift across the surface without settling, and the surrounding field of clashing bars and loops refuses to recede. The result reads as crowded pressure rather than open space.
